observation.visible_scene: A man with multicolored powder (green, blue, red, yellow) smeared on his face, short hair, and white t-shirt stands against a solid purple studio background. His right hand, with yellow powder caked on the fingertips, is held cupped just below his mouth, and a loose cloud of yellow-green powder dust fills the air on the left side of the frame.
visible_changes: The powder cloud on the left is already present at the first frame and steadily thins, spreads, and fades throughout the clip, ending as only a faint haze.
The man's expression shifts from a neutral, pursed-lip look in the early frames to a widening grin that shows his teeth by the middle frames, which he holds to the end.
His eyes, open for most of the clip, narrow and then close in the final frames as he smiles.
The cupped hand drifts slightly downward away from his mouth toward his chin/neck over the sequence, while the head tilts a little.
The colored powder on his face, hair, and shirt, and the yellow on his fingertips, remain essentially unchanged (persistent).
outside_clip_unknowns: The action that produced the airborne powder cloud (e.g., a blow or throw) occurred before the first sampled frame and is not shown.
What the man does after the last frame (whether the smile, hand position, or remaining haze changes further) is unseen.
uncertain_details: Whether the small change in framing/subject position across the clip is due to camera movement or the man shifting his body cannot be determined from the static purple background.
The exact path and timing of the hand's downward motion are approximate; the motion is slow and partly a change in pose rather than a large translation.
observation.visible_scene_note: This is a temporally cropped excerpt; the powder dispersal is an already-ongoing process at the start and continues to the end, not a complete event.
